E8_resolution_olmo32b_template.issue: the official chat template injects a default system block whenever no message carries role=='system', leaking a persona ('You are Olmo'), a builder attribution ('Ai2'), a hardcoded knowledge cutoff ('date cutoff is December 2024'), a weights URL and a tool-availability statement into what must be a bare scoring prompt

verification.method: rendered the byte-verified pinned chat_template.jinja with jinja2 for all six frozen conditions under both message shapes, then ran every render through the SAME gate function the on-GPU preflight uses (silent_influence.final_preflight_checks.check_render). No weights, no model, no GPU.
verification.tools_argument_note: transformers passes tools=None when none are supplied, which this protocol never does; the render mirrors that exactly

frozen_render_hashes_for_preflight_repro.note: sha256 of the rendered TEXT for the canonical preflight task wildbench/00c7916a072b4947 with the standard placeholder answer, empty-system variant. The on-GPU preflight must reproduce these, which is fail condition 5.

incidental_findings: the repo ships the template TWICE (chat_template.jinja and an embedded copy in tokenizer_config.json). Both are byte-identical (same sha256) and render identically on the empty-system path, so the transformers precedence rule between them cannot change what the model receives.

unlike Mistral, the injected date is a hardcoded literal rather than strftime_now, so this template's render is stable across calendar days and does not carry Mistral's cross-day reproducibility defect.
pad_token (<|pad|>, 100277) differs from eos_token (<|endoftext|>, 100257), so batched padding and the terminator-trimming path must not assume they are equal.
add_generation_prompt is handled INSIDE the message loop and gated on loop.last, so it is a no-op for an empty message list; this protocol always supplies at least a system and a user turn.

S1_three_scorer_sensitivity.status: robustness check, NOT a correction of a confound
S1_three_scorer_sensitivity.label: primary recomputed on the three non-OLMo scorers
S1_three_scorer_sensitivity.motivation: the frozen candidate answers were generated by allenai/Olmo-3-7B-Instruct, and the fourth scorer is allenai/Olmo-3.1-32B-Instruct: a different version and size, but the same model family. A reader may reasonably ask whether same-family affinity drives the result.
why_it_is_robustness_and_not_confound_co: the scoring prompt never identifies the author of the content: no model name, no provenance, no authorship claim appears anywhere in the frozen prompt (verified by scanning the rendered prompt for model identifiers). Scorer-facing generator identity is anonymous.
for a given task the candidate answer is BYTE-IDENTICAL across all six conditions (one frozen answer per task, hashed and reused).

therefore any family-affinity term is constant within a (task, scorer) cell across conditions and cancels exactly in the paired within-cell difference no_history - self_low_2. It cannot manufacture or reverse a condition contrast.

what family affinity could plausibly shift is the LEVEL of the scores, not the contrast. A level shift matters only through a range/ceiling mechanism: if this scorer rates same-family text near the top of the scale, there is less headroom for a downward manipulation to move it, which would compress rather than inflate the measured effect. Compression works against the hypothesis, so this is a conservative direction.
S1 is prespecified precisely so that this reasoning is testable rather than merely asserted.

estimand_primary_population.population: the same 500 fully held-out arena_hard + wildbench tasks

S1_three_scorer_sensitivity.bootstrap: the SAME resampled task-sets as every other statistic in the plan (shared draws, 10,000 replicates, seed 20260818, task-clustered, dataset-stratified, percentile CI). No new draws are taken.
S1_three_scorer_sensitivity.also_reported_on: the automatic-parser complete-case basis, like every other estimand (R3)
reported: the fourth scorer's own cell means with N, so its individual behaviour is visible
explicitly_forbidden: S1 may never replace, override or become the primary analysis
no rule may switch the primary from the four-scorer 8-cell macro on the basis of S1 or of any observed data (this preserves plan v2's no_conditional_rule_changing_primary_from_observed_data)
S1 disagreeing with the primary is reported as a limitation of interpretation, not as grounds for discarding either estimate
S1_three_scorer_sensitivity.interpretation_guidance: if the three-scorer and four-scorer macro averages agree within their intervals, same-family affinity is not driving the result. If they differ materially, the write-up must report both and discuss the fourth scorer's level and range behaviour, without recasting either as the corrected number.
